description: This file defines the ProspectList class, a PHP class extending SugarBean, which models prospect lists within SugarCRM / SuiteCRM. It includes properties for prospect list attributes, methods for querying, relationships, and managing prospect list entries.

classes.name: ProspectList
classes.description: Represents a prospect list in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, with properties for list attributes, and methods for creating queries, managing relationships, counting entries, and other list operations.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the prospect list's name.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to retrieve prospect lists with optional order and filtering, including joins to related user data.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates an SQL query for exporting prospect list data, joining user information.

methods.name: create_export_members_query
methods.description: Builds a complex SQL union query to fetch members (accounts, contacts, prospects, users, leads) associated with a prospect list, including custom fields.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Overrides parent's method to save relationships, setting prospect relationships based on lead, contact, and prospect IDs.

methods.name: set_prospect_relationship
methods.description: Establishes relationships between a prospect list and related entity IDs for a given link name.

methods.name: set_prospect_relationship_single
methods.description: Sets a single relationship link between a prospect list and a related entity.

methods.name: clear_prospect_relationship
methods.description: Removes a specific relationship between a prospect list and a related entity ID.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Placeholder for marking relationships as deleted (empty implementation).

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Empty stub, intended to populate additional list fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional detail fields, including entry count.

methods.name: update_currency_id
methods.description: Stub for updating currency IDs (empty implementation).

methods.name: get_entry_count
methods.description: Returns the count of non-deleted prospect list entries from the database.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data array for list view, including entry count.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Creates a SQL WHERE clause for a generic search on the prospect list name.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current prospect list object, invoking parent save.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the prospect list as deleted in the database.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the bean implements a given interface (e.g., ACL).
